title: Reflux
summary: RE'FLUX, noun [Latin refluxus.] A flowing back; the returning of a fluid; as the flux and reflux of the tides; the flux and reflux of Euripus.

inlines.v: RE'FLUX, noun [Latin refluxus.] A flowing back; the returning of a fluid; as the flux and reflux of the tides; the flux and reflux of Euripus.
